notes: Cooling tower point dictionary (library-authored family, opened 2026-08-18; no reference chapter exists). LOOP-SIDE SEMANTICS: water LEAVING the tower is the COLD side and ENTERS the chiller condenser — so tower_leaving_temp grounds as Entering_Condenser_Water_Temperature_Sensor and tower_entering_temp (warm, chiller-to-tower) as Leaving_Condenser_Water_Temperature_Sensor, the same physical stream as points/chw.points.json cwst (see its loop-side warning). Bind per tower cell where cells are sensed individually; plant-level binding uses the common headers.

points.name: tower_leaving_temp
points.description: Tower leaving (cold, basin/sump outlet) condenser water temperature

s223.pattern: Sensor observes QuantifiableObservableProperty on the condenser water entering connection point (tower outlet)

points.name: tower_entering_temp
points.description: Tower entering (warm, chiller-leaving) condenser water temperature

s223.pattern: Sensor observes QuantifiableObservableProperty on the condenser water leaving connection point (chiller outlet)

points.notes: Same physical stream as chw dict cwst (duplicated per the lint's own-family resolution rule). Range = tower_entering_temp − tower_leaving_temp.

points.name: oa_wetbulb

s223.pattern: QuantifiableObservableProperty at the outdoor air reference; typically host-computed

points.notes: Host-derived when no physical wet-bulb sensor exists (the common case): psychrometric calculation from drybulb + RH + station pressure. A MULTIVARIABLE derivation — harder class than the P-T saturation lookups (hp dict evap_sat_temp precedent) and more error-prone near saturation; the host must document its psychrometric routine and accuracy. Simulation supplies it natively (EnergyPlus Site Outdoor Air Wetbulb).

points.name: tower_fan_speed

s223.pattern: QuantifiableObservableProperty on the tower fan motor via hasProperty

points.notes: Same grounding convention as hw dict hw_pump_vfd_speed. The at-capacity gate for the approach rule: approach is only diagnostic when the fan can no longer compensate (4-climate simulation study: healthy approach spans 1.6-13.3 degC un-gated purely from fan modulation).

points.name: tower_fan_status

s223.pattern: EnumeratedObservableProperty on the tower Fan via hasProperty

points.notes: Consumed by the fan short-cycling rule (starts-per-hour edge counting; Logical.Edge Nyquist ceiling window/(2·dt) applies — RTU-0001 precedent).
